verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a public Marketing Emails API for programmatically creating, updating and retrieving marketing emails, which covers the creation half of the story. Scheduling at a specific date and time is documented only in the dashboard editor knowledge-base article, not as an API operation, so a fully dashboard-free schedule-and-send flow is unproven. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint for scheduling or sending an email/campaign, API-level audience and send-time configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: You can use the Marketing Emails API to programmatically create, update, and get details about marketing emails.
To retrieve a list of all emails, make a `GET` request to `/marketing/v3/emails`
